atoms.label: supported
atoms.rationale: D1 explicitly states that neither threaded nor async actor models bypass the GIL.

atoms.label: insufficient
atoms.rationale: No passage states the default threaded-actor max_concurrency. D2 explicitly configures 2 in an example; an explicit configuration does not determine or contradict the default.

atoms.label: supported
atoms.rationale: D2 explicitly states that at least one async def method causes classification as an async actor instead of a threaded actor.

atoms.label: contradicted
atoms.rationale: D1 explicitly states that asyncio remote tasks are unsupported, shows the direct async remote-task definition failing, and prescribes a synchronous wrapper.
